stem.text: A possible mechanism for the exothermic hydrolysis of 2-chloro-2-methylpropane is shown.

stem.alt: Two-step mechanism: (CH3)3CCl slow to (CH3)3C+ and Cl-; then (CH3)3C+ plus OH- fast to (CH3)3COH.

stem.text: Which diagram represents the reaction pathway diagram for this mechanism?

A.alt: Reaction pathway energy profile with one peak.

B.alt: Reaction pathway energy profile with two peaks; the first peak is higher than the second.

C.alt: Reaction pathway energy profile with two peaks; the second peak is higher than the first.

D.alt: Reaction pathway energy profile with three peaks; the middle peak is the highest.
